messages:
Ava (People Ops): Heads-up — we're doing a series of mini award ceremonies next month for cross-office recognition (15–20 min each). Need hosts, a short script, and logistics owners for each site. Who can help run them? :sparkles:
Jonas (People Ops): I can host SF and help draft a 90s script. Budget per site?
Priya (People Ops): happy to draft script + cue cards. also can take care of names + pronunciation list.
Emma (Events): @Ava copying calendar now. We have 30-min venue slots at SF on 5/12, NY on 5/14, LON on 5/20. AV carts available but need 48h lead.
Tom (Facilities): AV cart requests: please fill this form so we can stage gear -> https://intra/redwood/facilities/av-request :calendar:
Ava (People Ops): Budget: $200/site for snacks + $150 for small physical token (pin/sticker). Approvals queued. If teams want catered, they need to top up.
Marta (People Ops Intern): I can make name tags and bring the sign-in clipboard for each office.
Priya (People Ops): Script draft (very short):
```
Intro (30s): host name + why we're here
Callout (60s): 2-3 short calls from peers (pre-lined) + one manager note
Hand-off (30s): give token + group pic
Close (10s): quick selfie and thank you
```
Ava (People Ops): love it. keep it tight. we'll collect 2 peer quotes per awardee prior to event.
Emma (Events): we'll add a volunteer coordinator in each office to wrangle timing. @Tom can you confirm capacity for max 25 people at each venue?
Tom (Facilities): SF and NY OK for 25. LON capped at 18 (fire code). If LON >18 we'll split into two micro-sessions.
Jonas (People Ops): Do we want any video capture for montage? remote folks love the clips.
Emma (Events): yes, short vertical clips are fine. We'll bring a phone gimbal. If teams want pro recording we need +48h sign-off and budget.
Priya (People Ops): I'll send a Google sheet to collect names, pronouns, peer quotes, dietary restrictions. Link will be in the thread soon.
Ava (People Ops): checklist for owners: host, script, tokens, snacks, AV form, sign-in sheet, photo lead. I'll tag owners once we have volunteers.
Marta (People Ops Intern): will print tokens and help with photos on the day.
people-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: fill AV form by 1769999000 to guarantee cart delivery.
Jonas (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll pair with @Priya on SF run-through next Tuesday. :thumbsup:
